glossary.definition: (A)(1) "Health care entity" means an entity, whether acting on its own behalf or on behalf of or in affiliation with other health care entities, that conducts as part of its regular business activities professional credentialing or quality review activities involving the competence of, professional conduct of, or quality of care provided by health care providers, including both individuals who provide health care and entities that provide health care.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 2305.251 to 2305.253 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (2) "Health care entity" includes any entity described in division (A)(1) of this section, regardless of whether it is a government entity; for-profit or nonprofit corporation; limited liability company; partnership; professional corporation; state or local society composed of physicians, dentists, optometrists, psychologists, or pharmacists; accountable care organization; other health care organization; or combination of any of the foregoing entities.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 2305.251 to 2305.253 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Health insuring corporation" means an entity that holds a certificate of authority under Chapter 1751. of the Revised Code. "Health insuring corporation" includes wholly owned subsidiaries of a health insuring corporation.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 2305.251 to 2305.253 of the Revised Code:
As used in this section and sections 2305.251 to 2305.253 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Incident report or risk management report" means a report of an incident involving injury or potential injury to a patient as a result of patient care provided by health care providers, including both individuals who provide health care and entities that provide health care, that is prepared by or for the use of a peer review committee of a health care entity and is within the scope of the functions of that committee.
glossary.normalized: incident report or risk management report
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 2305.251 to 2305.253 of the Revised Code:
glossary.term: Incident report or risk management report

glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 2305.251 to 2305.253 of the Revised Code:
As used in this section and sections 2305.251 to 2305.253 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Physician" means an individual authorized to practice medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or podiatric medicine and surgery.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 2305.251 to 2305.253 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Sickness and accident insurer" means an entity authorized under Title XXXIX of the Revised Code to do the business of sickness and accident insurance in this state.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 2305.251 to 2305.253 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (H) "Tort action" means a civil action for damages for injury, death, or loss to a patient of a health care entity. "Tort action" includes a product liability claim, as defined in section 2307.71 of the Revised Code, and an asbestos claim, as defined in section 2307.91 of the Revised Code, but does not include a civil action for a breach of contract or another agreement between persons.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 2305.251 to 2305.253 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (I) "Accountable care organization" means such an organization as defined in 42 C.F.R. 425.20.
